Roots displayed in decimals remain approximate.

value.rationale: The natural long-time Fourier test of a geometry-preserving numerical Brownian scheme detects a sharp, analytically certified phenomenon that invariant-measure preservation and weak finite-time consistency cannot imply: the second harmonic becomes negatively correlated and then positively correlated again as steps grow. The exact first and second mode thresholds and all-mode upper bound are structurally motivated numerical maximum-fidelity diagnostics and give reproducible benchmarks; they are not arbitrary parameter slices.
